title: MAVEN/WikiEvents source funnel
execution: Annotations and texts reviewed; no model calls.
result: MAVEN validation39 broad Agent/Patient pairs in23docs,12 locally mentioned pairs in10docs; WikiEvents4 broad nearby pairs in3devdocs.
lesson: A natural development panel was possible, but source quality/ontology needed review.
limit: Candidate ceilings, not adjudicated gold; reviewed splits became exposed.

title: Six-document natural pilot
execution: 24 questions per Qwen0.5B/1.5B; adaptive1.5B wording follow-up.
result: Exact7/24,12/24,13/24 respectively; opposite-role outputs7/24,7/24,9/24.
lesson: Small models frequently confused participants within the requested event.
limit: Selected natural development data; prompting and labels not mechanism-isolating.

title: Gemma on the same natural pilot
execution: Hosted stronger model on the exposed six-document pilot.
result: Exact17/24; seven nonexact outputs plausibly same referents on post hoc review; zero unique wrong-role/event outputs and zero identical role-answer pairs.
lesson: The initial failure was not universal across models.
limit: Same old items; family/size/interface confounded; historical API experiment, no new call this audit.

title: Seventeen-document natural panel
execution: 68 questions; new documents relative to six-document pilot; three initial models, later Qwen7B gate.
result: Gemma exact46/68, unique alias63/68 and13/17 complete; Qwen0.5B27/68 alias,1.5B42/68.
lesson: Stronger performance transferred to new natural documents, with residual role errors.
limit: One-investigator screen, alias-sensitive grading; cross-model protocol prepared after Gemma results.

title: Qwen7B on the natural panel
execution: Same68-question panel, local7B checkpoint.
result: Exact49/68, frozen alias58/68;10/17 complete documents, six wrong-role answers; Conquering30/32.
lesson: A local open model could support causal instrumentation.
limit: Same exposed panel and annotation caveats; not a new independent corpus.

title: Three-event stress probe
execution: Four passages × three events × two roles × three marking conditions,72 answers/model.
result: Gemma70/72, Qwen7B63/72; marked conditions24/24 and24/24 Gemma,24/24 and23/24 Qwen.
lesson: Explicit markers made event retrieval nearly solved, reducing natural error-based discrimination.
limit: Some documents reused; development only; no internal event variable identified.

title: Literal A→B label patch
execution: Three development passages, two roles; layer scan with same-label shams.
result: Layers0–16 redirected first-token preference6/6; late20–27 did not.
lesson: The patching pipeline can transfer a literal event-label cue.
limit: Equivalent to asking B; not a discriminator of semantic binding.

title: Same-letter reordered-event state
execution: Development layer search with fixed question letter and changed label/event assignment.
result: Layer16 gave target-event complete answers6/6; neighboring/identity controls retained original preference6/6 each.
lesson: The transferred state carried contextual answer-source information beyond its literal token identity.
limit: Order, compound key and distributed answer retrieval remained competing explanations.

title: One-document full-answer follow-up
execution: Untouched follow-up within the development lineage; full greedy decoding.
result: Agent became Brock Lesnar as intended; Patient became Christian instead of CM Punk.
lesson: A promising first-token redirection did not ensure correct participant binding for both roles.
limit: One document; cannot identify the responsible mechanism.

title: Five fresh defeat documents
execution: Fixed layer16/site;10 role queries plus identity,neighbor and direct controls.
result: Untreated/direct10/10, patched9/10 and4/5 complete documents; controls10/10.
lesson: The fixed state intervention genuinely redirected answer source on fresh documents.
limit: Small one-family natural panel, added labels, no independent annotation adjudication.

title: Cross-document donor diagnostic
execution: Adaptive foreign donor on the same five recipient documents.
result: Recipient second-event answers8/10, no donor-name copies; first-event donor10/10 original answers.
lesson: Transfer did not require copying donor participant names; event order/address cue remained plausible.
limit: Adaptive, not an independent confirmation; does not separate event identity from ordinal/key selection.

title: Scoring relation extension
execution: Three fresh documents,30 condition rows; same site/layer.
result: Agents redirected3/3, zero complete two-role documents; system requested person while Patient required team.
lesson: The proposed new-relation replication was not interpretable as a binding test.
limit: Patient competence and person/team contract were invalid; no adaptive re-scoring into success.

title: First discourse-load probe
execution: 16 event pairs,64variants,384 answers.
result: Singles128/128; joint bare64/64, bystander54/64, embedded64/64, both62/64;12 wrong-event outputs.
lesson: The preregistered embedded drop failed; bystander-only effect was confounded with capitalization.
limit: Do not attribute10/64 bystander-only errors to added people from this study.

title: Fresh capitalization×bystander discriminator
execution: Fresh names; independent case and named-bystander factors.
result: Proper bare64/64 versus proper bystander57/64; seven wrong-event substitutions, all target-second; lower-case bystander54/64.
lesson: Added named bystanders can trigger wrong-event retrieval in this controlled Qwen panel beyond capitalization alone.
limit: Not a corpus-general law, no causal localization, small selected templates.

title: Named versus unnamed observers
execution: 24fresh pairs,72variants,1,296 answers across Qwen7B,Llama3B,Qwen1.5B.
result: Qwen7B joint bare96/96, unnamed96/96,named91/96 with four wrong-event+one observer; Llama96/92/85 and Qwen1.5B71/59/51.
lesson: The named-entity effect has some new-item support but magnitude/error types vary by model.
limit: One Qwen named-observer single also failed; no strong universal behavioral law.

title: Natural factuality join and review
execution: 710shared document IDs,15,405event joins; two36document source samples.
result: 22provisional source-valid single-event cards each round; only two within-document same-type leads in first round.
lesson: A large joined dataset did not automatically yield a clean confirmatory contrast set.
limit: One-reader/AI investigator judgments; not representative quality estimation or independently reviewed gold.

title: Six source-derived factual/nonfactual pairs
execution: 24joint answers, both orders and both status-conditioned target demands.
result: 13/24 correct,zero of six complete; target-first10/12 versus second3/12.
lesson: Natural composition/competition was difficult, with serious sentence-order competition.
limit: Convenience source selection and strict span scores; not a clean compositional deficit.

title: Factuality/Agent component follow-up
execution: Same exposed12sentences,24single-sentence answers after joint pilot.
result: Status10/12,Agent11/12; only3/6 pairs complete on all components.
lesson: Joint and single-sentence performance differ; some prerequisite competence also fails.
limit: Post-pilot; different question contracts and sentence-order rival remain.

title: Cross-model source-pair diagnosis
execution: Same exposed six source pairs,24answers/model.
result: Qwen1.5B13/24, Llama14/24;zero complete pairs each; Llama first/second7/12 each.
lesson: The strong Qwen7B order pattern did not replicate uniformly.
limit: Development comparison, not new source confirmation.

title: Clean synthetic factuality discriminator
execution: Fresh24pairs,96joint answers/model; Qwen7B components also measured.
result: Qwen7B and Llama both95/96,23/24complete; Qwen1.5B60/96,1/24complete. Qwen7B status-only27/48,Agent48/48.
lesson: Strong models solve the clean joint task; the natural failure does not establish a general inability to combine status and participants.
limit: Component wording itself poor; near-perfect joint behavior blocks the proposed broad deficit claim.

title: Initial cross-model role-path patch
execution: Four role-reversal pairs,8correct baseline prompts/model,nine fixed cuts,self-patch controls.
result: Late Qwen state sufficiency and earlier Llama shifts; two Llama full-name token margins invalid.
lesson: Whole-state answer redirection was feasible but is not a measure of when roles are first represented.
limit: Tiny synthetic panel, sparse controls, first-token scorer failure in half Llama cases.

title: Full-dimensional paths and PCA
execution: Same8prompts/model,29stages,four token sites; Qwen3584D,Llama3072D.
result: 2D PCA retained46%/52% final-token contrast variance; input-name distance starts at embeddings, unchanged-token distance later.
lesson: Different positions/depths show different response development.
limit: Plots omit dimensions and cannot identify semantic operations; same underlying cases.

title: Why one trajectory is not enough
execution: Full-dimensional Gram and speed analyses with unrelated controls.
result: Role Gram Qwen.82/Llama.79, unrelated.92/.90; speed correlations about.98–.99; largest5steps85%Qwen versus53%Llama role travel.
lesson: The first Path-Cosine proposal mistakes generic progression for shared computation.
limit: Does not refute every possible relational response measure.

title: Role×voice×question factorial
execution: Four new lexical families;64recorded rows but48distinct prompts/model; full-name scorer.
result: Qwen2/4 fully competent families,Llama0/4; no hidden capture/causal run.
lesson: The intended clean cross-model factorial was not reached.
limit: Duplicate active rows disclosed; failed prerequisite is not a causal null.

title: Role versus mention-position syntax transport
execution: Fourfamilies; pre-question donor patches at frozen cuts on eligible development family.
result: Mean role effects Qwen+.195,Llama+.036nat, both<.5gate; wrong-site zero; no evaluation-family patches.
lesson: The proposed selective transported role effect failed its development rule.
limit: Some native families also failed competence; no cross-model shared role mechanism.

title: Indirect-support feasibility
execution: Six paired seeds,shared-two versus shared-zero support.
result: The proposed beneficial direction failed; observed pattern reversed.
lesson: A positive intuitive graph prediction was not supported.
limit: One graph context; no general reverse law.

title: Matched indirect-support replication
execution: Six fresh paired seeds with exact episode matching.
result: The earlier reverse pattern repeated locally.
lesson: There was a reproducible local graph-associated penalty.
limit: Shortest paths and other motifs still differed.

title: Same-distance indirect-support control
execution: 18models,three worlds×three seeds×two conditions;familiar≥99.80%.
result: World margin contrasts+.073,−4.670,−1.051;6/9negative,below7/9and all-world rule;within-model10/18negative.
lesson: The common-neighbor rule was not stable after shortest-distance matching.
limit: Other motifs differ; descriptive mean−1.883 does not override failed rule.

title: Many-world prospective support test
execution: 42models with additional graph worlds.
result: New-world effects mixed signs; the original single-graph rule failed.
lesson: The local graph finding did not generalize as a simple shared-neighbor law.
limit: Graph packages and initialization remain important; no causal scalar identified.

title: Role/event/position/distractor audit
execution: 42existing checkpoints, crossed controls.
result: Five weak models stayed near.5role while event>.93.
lesson: The weakness was not a generic event-identification failure; conditional role chance is.5, not.25.
limit: Reused models, no independent replication.

title: Padding and branch component retraining
execution: 16selected retrains: original,dedicatedPAD,fixedquery,fixedcandidate.
result: Weak original45–49%,PAD43–45%,fixedquery94.9–96.9%,fixedcandidate100%;familiar≥99.92%.
lesson: Padding alone did not rescue; changing branch learning could rescue selected models.
limit: Selected development models; does not identify a unique branch/circuit cause.

title: Linear role-probe diagnostic
execution: Selected-model linear probe validation.
result: Training validity failed.
lesson: No inference about role information absence is licensed.
limit: Decoder-class/optimization problem, not a representation null.

title: Embedding-distance intervention
execution: Selected weak-model embedding-separation edits.
result: Increasing focal embedding distance did not repair the bad models.
lesson: Raw input-identity distance alone did not explain the transfer failure.
limit: One intervention family; downstream representation mechanisms remain open.
